This PR makes the “Entire search” agent skill opt-in instead of being scaffolded automatically during `entire enable`, aligning skill installation with explicit user intent while keeping hook installation behavior unchanged.

**Changes:**
- Add `--search-skill` to `entire enable` (and `entire agent add`) to explicitly scaffold the `entire-search` skill for supported agents.
- Refactor search-skill scaffolding into dedicated helpers with updated markers and opt-in-aware tests.
- Remove pre-scaffolded `entire-search` agent files from the repo and update docs/changelog accordingly.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 12 out of 12 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

| cmd/entire/cli/setup_search_skill.go | Renames and hardens scaffolding logic (new marker + legacy support) and gates it behind `SearchSkill`. |

| cmd/entire/cli/integration_test/setup_claude_hooks_test.go | Removes assertions that the search skill is scaffolded by default. |
